schema_note: Generated by figgenie-paper-diagram/scripts/distill/build_thresholds.py from style_stats.py's summary.json (n=986 mechanism figures: 713 good / 203 ok / 37 bad / 33 discard, out of a 12577-row corpus index). See the style-rules.md next to this file for the prose version and full method.

double._note: width_p5_p95 upper bound clamped to 1.2 x the 504 pt target (raw p95 in width_p95_raw): the double-column population includes page-wide figures; see style-rules.md §10

contrast_method: good vs (ok+bad); Cliff's delta magnitude: negligible<0.147, small<0.33, medium<0.474, large>=0.474; Mann-Whitney U p-values Benjamini-Hochberg FDR-corrected across the 29 numeric metrics tested within each column split. 'warn' requires FDR p<0.05 AND non-negligible effect (numeric) or >=10pp frequency difference (categorical) AND both groups n>=10 in the pooled (column_split=='all') contrast, PLUS the same bar met within the single-column split alone (n=593 good/211 ok+bad), so that a different column mix between good and ok+bad cannot masquerade as a quality signal (column_eff counts: {'single': 832, 'double': 154}). Metrics that clear the pooled bar but fail the single-column replication and are therefore 'info': none. bad alone is only 37 rows -- see contrast_numeric_bad_only.csv for that diagnostic; it is not the rule source. Severities were assigned by build_thresholds.py --auto (no hand-set overrides).
